denominator.inclusion_rule: Include every distinct representation requirement, Lagrangian/equation term-slot, and anomaly/consistency requirement enumerated by CB-A, CB-B, and CB-C. Count physics requirements, not particles as an independent axis and not aggregate or duplicate source rows twice.
denominator.freeze_rule: v0.1 row IDs and meanings are immutable. A new target appends a row and increments the minor ledger version; a changed meaning creates a successor ID and a migration edge.
denominator.migration_rule: Never overwrite a prior verdict or silently merge rows. Record alias, supersedes, split_from, or merge_of edges with source evidence.

particles as an independent counting axis when their representations already own the requirement
